judgment.rationale: The visible Dock bar with no configured bands on secondary displays matches the open canonical report in issue 49604.
evidence: The reporter sees configured Dock items on the primary display but an empty Dock bar on both secondary displays.
Display detection and per-display enablement work, matching the behavior reported in issue 49604.
Issue 49604 includes a maintainer hypothesis that secondary Dock state may be initialized incorrectly.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a duplicate-link comment directing additional monitor and configuration evidence to issue 49604.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette creates a Dock bar on each enabled secondary display, but only the primary display renders the configured Dock items.
known_information: The report covers PowerToys 0.101.2362.0 installed through WinGet on a three-monitor system.
All displays are detected and their Dock enable switches work.
Issue 49604 reports the same blank secondary-display Dock and already has maintainer investigation.
inferences: This likely shares issue 49604's secondary-Dock state or band-initialization path, but no root cause is confirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The distinguishing symptoms are identical to issue 49604, including a visible bar, working monitor selection, and absent configured contents. A second implementation effort would fragment evidence without adding a distinct failure mode.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete report, automated triage comment, labels, assignees, and timeline.
Verified that issue 49604 remains open and contains matching reproduction evidence plus a maintainer request to inspect secondary-Dock settings state.
